method: First-author original English model renderings of individually selected self-contained Spanish Wiktionary lexical definitions, not dictionary-provided English quotations, example sentences, native-human certification or universal meanings. Independent exact source-sense and wording review required before production.
scope: Bounded direct lexical batch: nouns, adjectives, adverbs, interjections and numerals. No form-of, opaque synonym, inferred inflection or alias authority; current accepted guesses and answer eligibility unchanged.

limitations: Each source record hash is SHA256 of the exact original compressed-archive decompressed JSON line bytes, including its original line ending; zero-based senseIndex binds only the selected source sense.
Only lexical source fields are retained here; examples, quotations, translations into other languages, media, pronunciation and unrelated senses are omitted.
All proposed spellings were still missing under the pinned H coverage audit; 81 candidate meanings are not measured added coverage.
